body:
Yes the textures look buns i know

# Enhanced Elytras

Adds two types of Elytras to make pvp a lot easier!

### Weighted Elytra

Functions as a mace + elytra. Dive bomb your enemies to instantly smash attack them. Enchantable with mace enchantments

### Bladed Elytra

Comes in tiers by material, functions as a spear + elytra. Quickly fly through your enemies to damage them just like a spear. Enchantable with spear enchantments.

### Crafting

Crafted with an elytra surrounded by two of its material

\[Material] \[Elytra] \[Material]

For the bladed elytras, the material is the respective material type (except netherite, where you have to upgrade it in a smithing table)

For the weighted elytra, the material is a heavy core
